name: DenseVoxelDraw FrontPeek
definition: A rendering method similar to Front but with scaling and 'peek' capability, drawing top and front faces if the voxel is on the top boundary or has empty space above it.
summary: DenseVoxelDraw FrontPeek is a diagonal rendering method that casts rays along the Y-axis to find the first visible voxel, uniquely drawing top and front faces when the voxel is on the top boundary or has empty space above it.
